description.value: A full-service provincial campground on warm, shallow Wasa Lake in a sunny Kootenay valley, with 2,000 m of sandy beach, an 8 km paved loop cyclists can ride around the lake, and a striking Purcell and Rocky Mountain backdrop; just 1 km off Highway 93/95 with showers on site. Powerboats share the lake all summer.

address.value: Wasa Lk Pk Dr, Wasa, BC V0B 1X0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Primary evidence is the BC Parks website for Wasa Lake Park, which confirms an active frontcountry campground with an online 'Book camping' function and reservation policies listed; OSM tags supply capacity (104), operator (EK Parks Ltd.), and explicit power_supply=no/internet_access=no flags. The website mentions an 8 km paved 'Wasa Lions Way' cycling loop around the lake but does not describe individual site types, showers, water, or other amenity specifics, so those are marked null. OSM power_supply=no is not corroborated by website text, so device/e-bike charging are left null per the OSM-not-authoritative rule.
concerns: OSM website points to the BC Parks park page rather than operator EK Parks Ltd.'s own site (email: info@ekparks.com); EK Parks may maintain a separate website with fuller amenity detail.
Phone number (+1-250-422-3003) is from OSM and is not explicitly corroborated in the BC Parks website content fetched.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active BC Parks campground with 104 sites, an on-site paved cycling loop, and online booking — a clear fit for touring cyclists on the Rocky Mountain Trench corridor.

wow_evidence: 2,000 m of sandy beach... warm, shallow Wasa Lake... 8 km paved loop cyclists can ride around the lake
